description: Rename an existing Gmail label, or change its visibility. Takes the label ID (from gmail_list_labels), not the label name. Renaming a label keeps it on every message already labelled with it.

account.description: Optional email address of the connected account to use (e.g. 'user@gmail.com'). If omitted, the default account is used.

label_id.description: The label ID to update (from gmail_list_labels)

label_list_visibility.description: Whether the label shows in the label list: labelShow, labelShowIfUnread, or labelHide

message_list_visibility.description: Whether the label shows on messages in the message list: show or hide

name.description: New label name. Nested labels use '/' (e.g. 'Alerts/Invoices')

name: gws-mcp__gmail_update_label
